fix(camellia): adjust device page scroll height

Summary:
- Make the device list card own the fixed viewport height and keep only the left list vertically scrollable.
- Let device property rows render at their natural height with horizontal overflow only for narrow detail widths.

Rationale:
- The device page should not add a nested right-side property scroller or artificial blank page height; the page height should be driven by the taller visible side.

- just camellia typecheck
- just camellia build
- just camellia check
